messages:
Maya (Finance): FYI Product wants to pilot new seat-fee model plus A/B pricing for mid-market next month. Need quick agreement on grandfathering, mid-cycle handling, invoice identifiers for reconciliation, and vendor constraints. Looping in @Rohan @Hannah.

Leila (Product): Plan: control = current list, variant A = +5% list + $2/seat, variant B = +12% list + $1/seat but heavier volume discounts. Cohort = 4% mid-market for 21 days. Want experiment_tag in export rows; no visible PDF changes.

Rohan (Billing Ops): Ops notes: adding experiment_tag to billing_export is trivial. Seat-fee line-items will appear on consolidated invoice; mid-cycle seat moves create prorate complexities. Proposed flow: provisional invoice uses days-prorate for seat-fees + provisional bucket assignment; month-end recon compares actual usage and issues corrections per thresholds.

Carlos (Sales): Sales wants default 90-day grandfathering for active discounts; AMs can opt-in customers earlier. Also request explicit exclusion for negotiated priced deals.

Hannah (Legal): 90 days ok. Need short customer wording and an opt-out/opt-in path. Suggest "Existing agreements are honored for 90 days after assignment; account teams can opt customers into the pilot sooner."

Maya (Finance): Decision summary: 1) export experiment_tag: yes 2) invoice PDFs: no 3) grandfathering: 90d with opt-in 4) mid-cycle: provisional-prorate + month-end recon. Rohan, confirm thresholds for adjustments?

Rohan (Billing Ops): Thresholds proposed: >$50 corrected invoice, $10-$50 credit memo, < $10 auto-credit. Will check gateway support for corrected invoice numbers (Stripe vs Chargebee). If unsupported, fallback to credit + explanatory invoice.

billing-bot: Scheduled job "seat-fee-ab-canary" for 2025-02-20T09:00:00Z (job id: seat-ab-2025-02-20).

Leila (Product): Acceptance criteria: revenue delta within +/-2% for cohort, <0.75% increase in billing tickets, and experiment_tag present in exports for 100% of cohort events.

Rohan (Billing Ops): Quick SQL snippet for export change I'll deploy to staging:
```sql
ALTER TABLE billing_export ADD COLUMN experiment_tag text;
UPDATE billing_export SET experiment_tag = audit.assignment_tag FROM audit_logs WHERE billing_export.account_id = audit.account_id AND billing_export.month = audit.month;
```
I'll run a backfill and post sample CSV.

Carlos (Sales): I'll send the exclusion list (negotiated deals) by EOD.

Hannah (Legal): I'll draft email copy and a short amendment template for opt-ins.

Maya (Finance): Thanks. Rohan, post runbook + vendor check here when done and we'll gate rollout on staging recon showing <=2% delta. :thumbsup:
